description: This file defines a C# data set class for unit tests, specifically for scenarios involving grains with Cyrillic IDs and names. It provides test data with various grain IDs, types, and states for use in relational storage testing within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: StorageDataSet2CyrillicIdsAndGrainNames
classes.description: A data set for grains with Cyrillic letters and IDs, implementing IEnumerable<object[]> for use in parameterized tests.

methods.name: GetTestData
methods.description: Returns test data including grain type, grain ID, and grain state based on the input test number.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator over the test data cases.
